name: The Diplomat Beach Resort
positioning: Beachfront resort in Hollywood, Florida, between Miami and Fort Lauderdale, now named the Signia by Hilton Diplomat Beach Resort, with ocean views and a modern beach club spirit
best_for: Couples and families who want a beachfront base between Miami and Fort Lauderdale
Travelers who like beach yoga, bike rides along the coast and live entertainment by the sea

facts.text: The resort carries its legacy forward with a modern beach club spirit.
The resort invites well-traveled couples and families.
The resort offers restorative spa treatments.
Guests can lounge poolside, join curated activities and enjoy live entertainment by the sea.
The resort has oceanfront venues and expansive event spaces for meetings and events.
Playa is a Latin-inspired oceanside restaurant with an open terrace with direct views of the Atlantic.
Playa has a dedicated kids' menu.
The resort is approximately 20 minutes from Fort Lauderdale-Hollywood International Airport and 35 minutes from Miami International Airport.

highlights.text: The resort is a beachfront destination placed between Miami and Fort Lauderdale.
Stays come with sweeping ocean views.
Guests can begin the morning with beachfront yoga.
Guests can explore the coastline by bike.
Diplomat Prime is the resort's signature steakhouse with a modern twist.

considerations.text: Pool access is reserved for resort guests.
Diplomat Prime asks guests to dress in relaxed professional or resort casual attire.
WhataHotel notes the large resort size may feel crowded during peak periods.

sources.title: Signia by Hilton Diplomat Beach Resort
